Professional Summary

Experienced Business Intelligence SME skilled in data analysis, automation, and visualization using Python, Snowflake, and Tableau. Expertise in dashboard development, reporting automation, and data-driven decision-making. Proven ability to optimize workflows, reduce costs, and enhance business intelligence strategies.

Professional Experience

Subject Matter Expert (SME) - Business Intelligence

Ziff Davis Performance Marketing, Pune | Dec 2019 - Present

Designed interactive dashboards for business performance evaluation.

Automated reporting and web scraping using Python, saving 8-12 hours daily.

Developed a Python-based internal tool for employee reporting, reducing 90% BI tool costs.

Administered Snowflake, managing company-wide data visualization & analytics.

Led training sessions and updated SOPs for process improvements.

Created and maintained Tableau dashboards for executive decision-making.

Built automation tools to enhance workflow efficiency and accuracy.

MIS Executive

Amazon Development Center (India) Pvt. Ltd, Pune | Apr 2018 - Mar 2019

Created and maintained daily, weekly, and monthly reports for business teams.

Supported internal teams with report generation and troubleshooting simple IT issues.

Assisted in maintaining data accuracy and standardized reporting templates.

Senior Associate (MIS)

Wipro Limited, Pune | Mar 2016 - Dec 2017

Created Excel VBA tools for database interactions and reporting.

Automated rosters, dashboards, and invoices for efficiency.

Projects

1. Sales Performance Dashboard using Snowflake & Tableau

Designed optimized data models and automated ETL pipelines using Python.

Integrated data from Convertr and Salesforce by automating report downloads using Python Playwright.

Reduced manual reporting time by 60% and improved data-driven decision-making.

Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) for data security.

Designed a Tableau dashboard for real-time insights from Snowflake & S3-stored data.

2. Automated Data Pipeline for Convertr, Salesforce & AWS S3

Automated XLSX report downloads from Convertr & Salesforce using Python Playwright, reducing manual effort.

Processed data using Snowflake Stages & AWS S3 (Athena) for efficient storage & retrieval.

Implemented data cleansing queries before appending data to Snowflake tables.

Built a Tableau dashboard for real-time visualization of cleaned data from both Snowflake and S3.

Technical Skills

Programming & BI Tools: Python, SQL, Tableau, Advanced Excel (VBA, Macros)

Databases & Cloud: Snowflake, MySQL, AWS (S3 Basics)

Automation & Libraries: Pandas, Playwright, BeautifulSoup, SQLite3, Tkinter

Version Control & OS: Git, Windows, Ubuntu Mate, Debian (Raspberry Pi 3B+)

Certifications

Google Project Management Professional Certificate

Hadoop Fundamentals – Simplilearn

Tableau Essential Training – NASBA

Education

Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting) | VSKUB University (2014)

Graduated with 65.85%

Additional Information

Languages: English, Tamil, Kannada, Telugu, Hindi, Marathi, Malayalam

Interests: Travel, Programming & Automation, Yoga
